title: Ed Policy: Packers will bring more "major events" to Lambeau Field

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ed Policy: Packers will bring more "major events" to Lambeau Field
sources.description: On Friday, Packers president and CEO Ed Policy reiterated his concern about the basic financial differences between a publicly-owned team and the 31 privately-held franchises.
